# Equity volatility surface: equity-vol-surface (EQV)

Implied vols by expiry and moneyness. One row per equity volatility surface per business date, keyed by SURFACE_ID. Read by the **market-data** pack's connector `market-store` (table `<root>/market/equity-vol-surface/`). Delivered **daily**, 60 business days (2026-07-08 to 2026-09-30): the first day's file is a **full snapshot** (15 records); the records never changed over the period, so every later day's file is empty. Drishti applies a day's file by key over the day before: a record absent from a day's file keeps its previous version, and nothing is ever deleted (an end is a changed status). 15 rows in all.

## File layout

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Path | `data/testdata/market-data/equity-vol-surface/` + `changes-YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl.gz`, `snapshot-YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl.gz` |
| Format | JSON Lines: UTF-8, one JSON object a line, gzip-compressed (`.jsonl.gz`) |
| Key field | `SURFACE_ID` |
| Date field | none in the record: the business date is the file's date (`snapshot-` or `changes-YYYY-MM-DD`), which becomes the lake's partition `business_date` |
| Promoted columns | none (the whole record is kept as `doc`) |
| Vector fields | none |
| Partitioned by | `business_date` |
| A day's file | a full snapshot on the first day, then only the changed records |

## One sample record

A real record, the most complete of the 15 (the one with the most non-empty fields), pretty-printed with two-space indents. **A string such as `"… 506 more numbers"` inside an array marks a fold**: it stands for the elements left out and is not part of the data.

```json
  "SURFACE_ID": "EQV-CSCA",

      "M_110": 36.64,

    },
    {
      "EXPIRY": "3M",
      "M_80": 42.93,
      "M_90": 40.13,
      "M_100": 37.33,
      "M_110": 36.44,
      "M_120": 35.54
    },
    "… 4 more elements of the same shape"
  ],
  "MODEL": "SVI, moneyness-quoted"
}
```

## Field reference

Every field of the record above, nested ones as dotted paths (`[]` marks an array of objects). *Required* is the contract's; *in N%* is how often the test data fills it.

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning | Values, format, unit | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `SURFACE_ID` | string | required | The record's id (the business key) | pattern `^EQV-` | `"EQV-CSCA"` |
| `UNDERLIER` | string | required | The equity or index: a TICKER of the equity kind (EQ-…) or an INDEX_ID of the equity-index kind (EQX-…). | — | `"EQ-CSCA"` |
| `ATM_1M` | number | required | The 1-month at-the-money implied volatility, in percent a year. | unit: percent | `37.54` |
| `ATM_1Y` | number | required | The 1-year at-the-money implied volatility, in percent a year. | unit: percent | `36.67` |
| `SKEW_1Y` | number | required | The 1-year skew: the volatility at 90% moneyness minus the volatility at 110%, in volatility points. | unit: vol points | `3.63` |
| `GRID` | array of objects | required | The surface: one object per expiry, shortest first, with the volatilities at 80% to 120% moneyness. | — | [6 objects] |
| `GRID[].EXPIRY` | string | required | The option expiry of the row (1M, 3M … 5Y). | one of `1M`, `1Y`, `2Y`, `3M`, `5Y`, `6M` | `"1M"` |
| `GRID[].M_80` | number | required | The implied volatility at a strike of 80% of spot, in percent a year. | unit: percent | `43.17` |
| `GRID[].M_90` | number | required | The implied volatility at a strike of 90% of spot, in percent a year. | unit: percent | `40.35` |
| `GRID[].M_100` | number | required | The at-the-money implied volatility (strike 100% of spot), in percent a year. | unit: percent | `37.54` |
| `GRID[].M_110` | number | required | The implied volatility at a strike of 110% of spot, in percent a year. | unit: percent | `36.64` |
| `GRID[].M_120` | number | required | The implied volatility at a strike of 120% of spot, in percent a year. | unit: percent | `35.74` |
| `MODEL` | string | required | The smile model and quoting of the surface (e.g. SVI, moneyness-quoted). | — | `"SVI, moneyness-quoted"` |

## Fields in other rows

None: all 15 rows were read, and every field any of them has is in the record above.

## For the production query

- **Identity:** one record per `SURFACE_ID` per `business_date`; the key is text, unique within the date.
- **Never null:** `SURFACE_ID`, `UNDERLIER`, `ATM_1M`, `ATM_1Y`, `SKEW_1Y`, `GRID`, `MODEL` (the contract's required fields).
- **Format:** JSON Lines, UTF-8, one object a line, gzip; field names exactly as shown (UPPER_SNAKE); dates `YYYY-MM-DD`; numbers as JSON numbers, never strings; a missing value is `null` or absent (an empty string is read as empty).
- **Arrays:** keep the order shown (vectors in the scenario set's or the run's order); nested objects as JSON, never flattened.
- Each day: the records new or changed that day (or all of them); Drishti keeps the rest from the day before.
- Unique: `SURFACE_ID` per business_date.
- `SURFACE_ID` matches `^EQV-`.
